why: Tier 1 per the operator's directive: review read path (src/runtime/live_review_due.py is a pure read, no writer, no order path), review-record validation (scripts/ci/check_live_review_records.py), the review-row schema, a reviewer contract doc and tests. No config/, no strategy or risk logic, no deploy/ and no change to any order, stop or account behaviour. It only changes which open packages the due gate lists as due for a review.
